title: A model reads installed early: the toast fires while its weight is still being verified, and the app never re-checks
description: Fabio installed ILL Anime 2026-10-13: the 'installed' toast fired, but the model was missing from the project's picker until he opened the Model Library. Root cause: the local downloader's 'end' handler drops the dep from _activeDownloaders BEFORE the sha256 verify (a resumed download re-reads the whole 6.9 GB, ~34 s). The reconciler skips deps the transport still holds (_isDepTransportLive), so it saw all bytes in, nothing holding it, settled the dep complete, and the model rollup broadcast download:complete at 00:01:42. The renderer re-synced while the .cubricdl marker was still on disk, so ILL Anime read not-installed. The real end at 00:02:03 broadcasts a per-dep complete only (modelId null), which never re-syncs. Fix: the dep stays transport-live through its verify.
